FN-VOOHLL-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 76
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Matt Simpson
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/10/2023
House Bill 76 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal
general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds,
municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase
the obligations of the State General Fund, local jails, the district attorneys, the Department of
Corrections, and the Bureau of Pardons and Paroles by an undetermined amount dependent upon
the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the
penalties imposed.
Page 1
